## Engineered for Reliability.
## Manufactured for Distribution.

AcuJoist® engineered wood I-Joists are manufactured in British Columbia and supplied across North
America through a network of trusted distributors. Each joist is built to meet stringent APA
performance standards, using a formaldehyde-free adhesive and SPF flanges sourced from responsibly
managed forests.

Tested under the APA PRI-400 and PRI-405 programs, AcuJoist products deliver proven strength,
stability, and consistent quality for a wide range of floor and roof applications. Our manufacturing
process integrates MiTek® software compatibility and supports downstream customization by our
distribution partners.

## Automation That Delivers Consistency

Each joist is crafted to exact specifications using formaldehyde-free adhesives for safer indoor air
and reliable structural results. Our streamlined process ensures consistent performance, optimal
fit, and fewer issues during installation, giving builders confidence in every lift.

## Reliable Delivery Across North America

AcuJoist partners with distributors across diverse markets to ensure dependable, on-time delivery of
engineered I-Joists. Our logistics team supports complex supply schedules and high-volume
fulfillment with precision and consistency. Whether you're stocking for regional demand or
coordinating custom shipments, we’re equipped to deliver the performance and reliability your
customers expect.

## ACJ 40 Series

**Depths:** 9½″, 11⅞″, 14″, 16″

**Best Use:** General residential construction with environmentally responsible materials.
* Flanges: 2½″ x 1½″ proprietary-grade solid-sawn SPF lumber
* Web: 25/64″ engineered OSB
* Responsibly-sourced and forest certified
* No added urea-formaldehyde resins
* Built for performance and value

[ACJ 40 Series]

### Joist Design Software Support

AcuJoist I-Joists are compatible with leading design platforms trusted by engineers and builders
across North America.

**MiTek® SAPPHIRE™ Supply**

Whole-house EWP estimating, layout, and 3D modeling.

[Learn More →][10]
**iStruct® by Simpson Strong-Tie**

Real-time joist layout, member sizing, and design validation.

[Learn More →][11]

## Quality You Can Measure

Every AcuJoist flange is tension tested in-line for structural integrity prior to I-Joist assembly.
Using CSA and ASTM-verified standards and equipment calibrated by an ISO/IEC accredited third party
independent agency, our QA system stretches each 2x3 and 2x4 flange to as much as 10,999 pounds of
force, ensuring performance you can trust, flange after flange.

Every 2 hours during production, off-line testing is conducted to assess tension, stiffness, and
shear strength. These tests are performed in accordance with ASTM standards, with ultimate loads
reaching 3-4 times the design values.

Left End – Grip & Pull

Right End – Fixed Resistance

## Backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty

AcuJoist I-Joists are manufactured to meet the highest standards for strength, straightness, and
dimensional stability.

Each joist is produced under APA-certified programs (PRI-400 & PRI-405) and is built to perform
consistently throughout the life of the structure in which it’s used. Our formaldehyde-free adhesive
and precision manufacturing help ensure product integrity from plant to project.

All AcuJoist products are supported by a Limited Lifetime Warranty for added confidence throughout
your distribution network. Please see warranty documentation for further info
